description: A link to the existing English or Spanish contact form with a supported topic, machine number and non-personal message prefilled. It sends nothing and has no name, email or phone inputs. Message text appears in the URL; the person adds contact details on the page, reviews the form and presses Send.

machine.description: Machine number or short equipment label, without personal details.

message.description: Non-personal problem details. Names and contact information belong on the form, not in the link.

topic.description: A form topic. Feedback is supported by the English form only.

name: get_contact_form_link
